cycle_selection: day 11 at 06 UTC in each of the twelve 2023 source months; fixed before looking at amounts; whole-cycle development holdout also used by earlier weather realism study
failure_policy: retain dry/missing/negative cases and losses; no selection on observed rain; no claim of naturally ambiguous metadata in documented ERA5
scope: real original encoded NCAR ERA5 LSP point values, controlled coarsening and (in second arm) explicit artificial metadata shift; no weather forecast, independent annotation, physical sensor-error calibration or priority proof
